decisions.rationale: 2025 NOA shows $133,766 and the pay stub annualizes to about $138,000 versus the stated $154,500, a material shortfall requiring escalation.
Balance of $91,229 covers the $73,500 down payment, but an unexplained $13,330 deposit on 2026-04-10 is not documented.
Prairie Oak Appraisals (on the approved panel) valued the property at $491,000 on 2026-06-09, supporting the $490,000 price, with no conditions.
Signed letter on letterhead dated 2026-06-24 confirms permanent full-time employment past probation with base salary consistent with the application.
GDS is about 36.3% but TDS is about 45.9% (above 44%) with a 725 credit score, so a possible marginal exception must be escalated.
